label: DiffSinger note-controlled voice
summary: Optional phoneme- and note-controlled singing synthesis for an explicitly licensed experimental vocal lane.

handoffs.label: Render a controlled singer candidate
handoffs.intent: Test lyric, phoneme, note length, vibrato, and expression controls without locking EPRS to one singer model.
inputs: Original lyrics, phonemes, notes, and expression controls
Exact singer/vocoder model files and license record
outputs: A lossless vocal candidate and reproducibility manifest
steps: Verify model and vocoder licenses first
Render a short phrase before a full song
Compare with Qwen and Seed-VC candidates
verification: Check pronunciation, timing, pitch, noise, clipping, and checksum
Block public release until exact model rights are cleared

preserve: Lyrics, note data, model files, licenses, and raw candidate renders
avoid: Uncleared vocoder weights, living-artist imitation, and automatic public publishing
